info.text:
Financial sextortion reports hit 137 a day in 2025.
NCMEC got 50,000+ financial sextortion reports in 2025, up from 10,731 in 2022.
Scammers demand gift cards or crypto; the FBI says typical targets are boys 14-17.
NCMEC: "Cooperating or paying rarely stops blackmail." Don't pay, stop replying, save evidence, report at ic3.gov. Under 18: NCMEC's CyberTipline and Take It Down. It's not your fault. Need to talk: call or text 988.
Sources: NCMEC (June 2026), FBI.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
#scamalert #sextortion #onlinesafety #personalfinance #financeprostv
